issues.issue: Is Mexico able and willing to protect the claimant from private persecutors?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says police determine jurisdiction and treat crimes as state crimes with no other venue.
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to rebut the presumption of state protection; Mexico would provide reasonable protection if sought.

issues.issue: Did the claimant reasonably exhaust the state protection options available before fleeing?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he reported threats to police, filed a complaint, and had no other place to report.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not report all threats or seek higher-level redress; protection options not reasonably exhausted.
